evidence.observation: The speaker states that participants could lose some or all of their Bitcoin.
evidence.quote: You can risk losing some or all of your Bitcoin.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes placing $1,000 into the trading pool.
evidence.quote: if you got $1,000 into the trading pool

evidence.observation: The speaker describes a subsequent compounded amount working in the pool.
evidence.quote: Tomorrow, you're going to have $1,006.74 working for you.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that a larger amount in the trading pool produces larger earnings.
evidence.quote: The more money you got in the trading pool, the more you're going to make.

evidence.observation: The speaker says the calculator projection is based on a $500 starting amount.
The speaker directs viewers to click an external link and join his team.
evidence.quote: click the link below. Get on my team.

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to use a link and get started.
evidence.quote: click the link anywhere round this video that you see. Get started

evidence.observation: The speaker presents a projection of more than $361,749.95 after 60 months.
The speaker qualifies the earning claim as not guaranteed.
evidence.quote: This is not a guaranteed way of saying that you're going to earn Bitcoin

evidence.observation: A supplied frame visibly shows a trading bonus report with opening balance, trading bonus, closing balance, and trading-result columns.
A supplied frame visibly shows a calculator with 0.075 as the trading balance, 60 as the period in months, and displayed start and end values in U.S. dollars.
